name: Select
description: Styled native <select>. Keeps the OS picker, keyboard handling and form behaviour.

classes.ayy-select: Wrapper element. Draws the chevron and sets the height.

default.looks: Native <select> with a wash fill, line-strong border and a muted chevron at the inline end; the options popup is the OS one.

pressed.none: Pressing opens the OS picker, which draws its own state.

focus.looks: 2px ring just inside the edge; the border goes transparent.

disabled.looks: Control and chevron dim to --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor.

selected.none: The chosen option shows as the control's text; the OS marks it in the popup.

error.looks: Border 60% destructive, destructive focus ring. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: No loading look; disable it with a "Loading…" option until the options arrive, or use a Skeleton for the form.

multiple.looks: Renders a list box: no fixed height, no chevron.

scale.sm: Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm text.
scale.md: Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
scale.lg: Control lg height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), lg text.

sizes.width: Fills its container; long option text is cut with an ellipsis.

js: selectClass({ size?, className? }) → string for the wrapper; selectControlClass constant for the <select>

props....rest: All native <select> attributes; className goes to the <select>.

a11y: Label it like any input (Field + Label with for/id).
The native picker is fully accessible and mobile-friendly — don't replace it without a strong reason.
do: Use a select to choose one option from a longer list (country, time zone, role).
Put a sensible default first, or a disabled placeholder option.
dont: Don't use a select for 2–5 options that should all be visible — use Radio, or a Segmented control when the choice changes a view.
Don't use a select for actions — use a Dropdown menu.
Don't use a select to search thousands of options — put a search Input group above a List of results instead.
Don't use a select for yes/no — use a Switch or Checkbox.
